set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=de6ac186f9aa6f0e533edf2a2ef8ffcf13691396; BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903; SERIAL_NO='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'; git fetch origin "$BRANCH"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED"; git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; echo SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial_no='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial_no and p.vid==0x303A]
if len(m)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one emulator C6, got {[(p.device,p.serial_number) for p in m]}')
p=m[0]
print(p.device)
PY
); echo EMU_PORT=$PORT; echo EMU_SERIAL=$SERIAL_NO; if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1 && lsof "$PORT" >/tmp/c6_emu_port_holders 2>/dev/null; then echo PORT_BUSY_CLOSE_SERIAL_MONITOR; cat /tmp/c6_emu_port_holders; exit 42; fi; cd tests/zigbee_device_emulator; rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old; rm -rf build; idf.py set-target esp32c6 >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('sdkconfig')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED=y','# CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED is not set\nCONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_IAS_CONTACT=y')
p.write_text(s)
PY
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null; idf.py build >/dev/null; echo BUILD_OK; idf.py -p "$PORT" flash; echo FLASH_OK; cd ../..; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import time
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial_no='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
end=time.time()+15
while time.time()<end:
    m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial_no and p.vid==0x303A]
    if len(m)==1:
        print(m[0].device); break
    time.sleep(0.25)
else: raise SystemExit('emulator did not re-enumerate after flash')
PY
); echo POST_FLASH_PORT=$PORT; python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$PORT" --before default_reset --after hard_reset chip_id >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import time, serial
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial_no='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
end=time.time()+15
port=None
while time.time()<end:
    m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial_no and p.vid==0x303A]
    if len(m)==1:
        port=m[0].device; break
    time.sleep(0.2)
if not port: raise SystemExit('emulator port missing after validation reset')
print('CAPTURE_PORT='+port)
lines=[]
with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=0.15) as s:
    stop=time.time()+40
    while time.time()<stop:
        b=s.readline()
        if b:
            t=b.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip('\r\n')
            lines.append(t); print(t)
text='\n'.join(lines)
print('EMU_CAPTURE_LINES='+str(len(lines)))
print('MARKER_STARTED='+str('selected Zigbee emulator profile started' in text))
print('MARKER_TICK='+str('emulator tick=' in text))
print('MARKER_ABORT='+str('abort() was called' in text or 'Guru Meditation' in text))
PY
